race.description: Ararat Rsl Sir Brudenell White Hwt Hcp (Bm70)
race.comment: None of these have raced over anything near 4000m before so it is a bit of a guessing game. EYE FOR AN EYE (2) likes to roll along near the pace and has a good a chance as any. Felt the pinch when they quickened last start over 2400m at Mornington and finished midfield. Won a 3200m hurdle last prep which is good grounding for an event like this. LEGEND BEAST (1) made a midrace dash to find the lead then held on gamely to score over 2400m at Swan Hill last time out. Was strong at the end of 3100m the run before so he looks a decent chance of running this out. MATTHEW MARK (3) mixes his form. Very good effort to go under by a long neck over 3100m at Warrnambool two back. A chance on that performance. BLACK RUTILE (10) has been whacking away and picking up minor money over races half as long as this of late. Hard to be too sure he will get 4000m but is going better than most. I LOVE THIS SONG (4) won a BM75 over 3150m at Mt Gambier two back which is a strong pointer.
